MP Cabinet Meets to Mark Modi's 25 Years, Vows Developed Madhya Pradesh by 2047

Madhya Pradesh Chief Minister Mohan Yadav chaired a special cabinet meeting to commemorate Prime Minister Narendra Modi's 25 years in public service. During the meeting, the cabinet passed a resolution vowing to achieve a developed Madhya Pradesh by the year 2047. Chief Minister Yadav highlighted the distribution of free rations to 80 crore people as a significant achievement during this period.
